company_description.value: Engaged in the acquisition and exploitation of music rights, with a music library of 34,000+ songs across major genres and 25+ languages, licensed to global digital platforms (YouTube, Spotify, JioSaavn, Apple Music, Amazon Prime Music, and others). Also has a legacy in Hindi and Punjabi film production (Film Division demerged FY22). Listed on BSE and NSE; incorporated 1996 (predecessor entity 1975); single reportable business segment (Music).

standalone_pbt_fy25_lakhs.source: Standalone Statement of Profit and Loss, Profit before Tax, FY25 - reported figure hardcoded directly rather than derived via Turnover-TC, since Turnover here is Revenue from Operations only (excludes Other Income of ~Rs 1,899 lakhs which is part of what generates the PBT). standalone_pbt_fy25_lakhs.flag: Margin (PBT/TC) will look unusually high (>200%) as a result - this is mathematically correct for a high-margin content-licensing business with low operating costs relative to revenue, not a data error.

ae_revenue_split.source: BRSR Section (Markets served by the entity): 'The contribution of exports is 68.66% of total turnover of the company.' Applied to Revenue from Operations (Rs 31,068.73 lakhs): export = 31,068.73 x 68.66% = Rs 21,335.79 lakhs; domestic = Rs 9,732.94 lakhs. Sum reconciles exactly to Turnover (row 12).
ae_revenue_split.flag: No foreign/international related parties appear in the Related Party Disclosure note (only Indian entities: Tips Films Limited, Mobify Technology Solutions) - so all AE rows are 0; the export revenue is licensing income from foreign THIRD-PARTY platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube etc are not AEs), not AE revenue. FY24 export % not found in this AR (appears to be a current-year-only BRSR disclosure) - left blank rather than guessed.

cash_fy25_lakhs.source: Standalone Balance Sheet, Cash and cash equivalents, FY25

ae_trade_receivables_fy25_lakhs.source: Trade Receivables note (total Rs 2,748.17 lakhs) does not itemize a related-party portion, and the Related Party Disclosure note's balances-outstanding section does not list any trade receivable balance with a related party (only Advance to Related Party, Trade Payables, Security Deposit Receivables) - entered as 0 based on that absence.

shareholding.source: Notes to Financial Statements - 'Details of equity shares held by Promoters in the Company' and 'Details of equity shares held by Promoters Group of the Company' (individual named holders, transcribed directly); 'Others' row is the balancing remainder against the Shareholding Pattern total (127,831,590 FY25 / 128,426,590 FY24 per the AR's own note on outstanding shares used for the % calculations). No named public/institutional shareholder individually met or exceeded 5% in the disclosed category breakdown, so all non-promoter holders are grouped.
